subject: Chemistry
title: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
summary: Carbonyl group (>C=O) planar (sp²) aur polar hai: carbon electrophilic, isliye aldehydes aur ketones nucleophilic addition karte hain. Aldehydes ketones se zyada reactive (kam steric hindrance, kam +I alkyl groups) — yahi relative reactivity hai.
Aldehydes aasaani se oxidise hote hain, isliye Tollens', Fehling's aur Benedict's reagents ko reduce karte hain; ketones aam taur par nahi. Ye tests dono ko alag karte hain.
α-hydrogen acidic hote hain, jisse aldol condensation (α-H ke saath) aur Cannizzaro reaction (α-H ke bina) hote hain. Methyl ketones haloform (iodoform) test dete hain.

Carboxylic acids phenols aur alcohols se strong acids hain (resonance-stabilised carboxylate). Electron-withdrawing (−I) groups acidity badhaate hain. Inke derivatives: acid chlorides, anhydrides, esters, amides.

formulas.name: Preparation from alcohols
formulas.formula: 1° alcohol + PCC (or CrO₃) → aldehyde;  2° alcohol + K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺ → ketone

formulas.name: Rosenmund reduction
formulas.mistake: BaSO₄ catalyst ko poison karta hai taaki aldehyde aage reduce na ho — iske bina alcohol ban jaata.

formulas.name: From nitriles and esters (Grignard, DIBAL-H)
formulas.formula: RCN + R′MgX → (H₃O⁺) R–CO–R′ (ketone);   RCN or RCOOR′ + DIBAL-H [AlH(i-Bu)₂] → (H₂O) RCHO
formulas.when: Nitriles se ketones banana, ya ester/nitrile ko aldehyde par rokna.
formulas.note: Excess RMgX ho to molecule mein pehle se maujood C=O 3° alcohol tak jaata hai, lekin –CN ketone par ruk jaata hai (imine salt par dobara attack nahi hota; ketone sirf hydrolysis par banta hai). LiAlH₄/NaBH₄ ester ko alcohol tak le jaate hain, aldehyde nahi.

formulas.name: Etard reaction and Gattermann–Koch
formulas.formula: toluene + CrO₂Cl₂ → benzaldehyde;  benzene + CO + HCl (AlCl₃/CuCl) → benzaldehyde

formulas.name: Nucleophilic addition
formulas.formula: HCN → cyanohydrin;  NaHSO₃ → bisulphite adduct;  ROH (dry HCl) → hemiacetal → acetal;  RMgX → alcohol
formulas.when: C=O group ki reactions (HCN, NaHSO₃, ROH, Grignard).
formulas.mistake: Reactivity: HCHO > CH₃CHO > CH₃COCH₃ (sterics aur +I effect) — ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Ammonia derivatives (addition–elimination)
formulas.formula: >C=O + H₂N–Z → >C=N–Z + H₂O  (Z = OH oxime, NH₂ hydrazone, NHC₆H₅ phenylhydrazone, NHCONH₂ semicarbazone)
formulas.mistake: 2,4-DNP saare aldehydes aur ketones ke saath orange/yellow precipitate deta hai — sirf aldehyde ka test nahi.

formulas.name: Clemmensen and Wolff–Kishner
formulas.formula: Zn–Hg/conc. HCl  or  NH₂NH₂ then KOH/ethylene glycol:  >C=O → >CH₂
formulas.when: Carbonyl ko alkane mein reduce karna.
formulas.mistake: Clemmensen acidic hai; Wolff–Kishner basic — molecule mein aur kya hai uske hisaab se chuno, galat chuna to group toot sakta hai.

formulas.name: Aldol condensation
formulas.mistake: Kam se kam ek α-H zaroori hai.

formulas.name: Cannizzaro reaction
formulas.note: Ek molecule oxidise aur ek reduce hota hai (disproportionation).

formulas.name: Haloform (iodoform) reaction
formulas.when: CH₃CO– aur CH₃CH(OH)– groups ka test.
formulas.mistake: Ethanol aur acetaldehyde dete hain; methanol aur propanal nahi — galti mat karo.

formulas.name: Acidity of carboxylic acids
formulas.formula: F₃CCOOH > Cl₃CCOOH > Cl₂CHCOOH > ClCH₂COOH > HCOOH > C₆H₅COOH > CH₃COOH
formulas.mistake: −I groups badhne ya –COOH ke paas aane par pKa ghatta hai (acid strong hota hai) — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Decarboxylation and Kolbe electrolysis
formulas.formula: RCOONa + NaOH/CaO → RH;  electrolysis of RCOONa → R–R

examples.title: Tollens' test
examples.problem: Propanal aur propanone ko kaise alag karoge?
examples.solution: Propanal (aldehyde) Tollens' reagent ke saath silver mirror aur Fehling's solution ke saath laal precipitate (Cu₂O) deta hai; propanone nahi.

examples.title: Iodoform test
examples.problem: Kaun iodoform test dete hain: ethanol, methanol, propan-2-ol, pentan-3-one?
examples.solution: Ethanol aur propan-2-ol (ye CH₃CO– compounds mein oxidise hote hain). Methanol aur pentan-3-one mein CH₃CO– ya CH₃CH(OH)– group nahi.

examples.title: Aldol ya Cannizzaro?
examples.problem: Benzaldehyde conc. NaOH ke saath; ethanal dil. NaOH ke saath.
examples.solution: Benzaldehyde mein α-H nahi → Cannizzaro: benzyl alcohol + sodium benzoate. Ethanal mein α-H → aldol (3-hydroxybutanal), garam karne par but-2-enal.

examples.title: Cross aldol
examples.solution: Claisen–Schmidt condensation: acetone (α-H wala) enolate banata hai jo benzaldehyde par attack karta hai → C₆H₅CH=CHCOCH₃ (benzalacetone).

examples.title: Acid strength
examples.solution: FCH₂COOH > ClCH₂COOH > CH₃COOH > CH₃CH₂COOH. F ka sabse strong −I effect; extra CH₂ (+I) propanoic acid ko kamzor karta hai.

examples.title: Reduction choice
examples.solution: Clemmensen reduction (Zn–Hg/HCl) ya Wolff–Kishner (NH₂NH₂, KOH, ethylene glycol): C₆H₅COCH₃ → C₆H₅CH₂CH₃.

examples.title: Ester se aldehyde
examples.problem: Ethyl propanoate (CH₃CH₂COOC₂H₅) → propanal. Kaunsa reagent: LiAlH₄ ya DIBAL-H?
examples.solution: Low temperature par DIBAL-H, phir H₂O: CH₃CH₂COOC₂H₅ → CH₃CH₂CHO (+ C₂H₅OH). LiAlH₄ poora propan-1-ol tak reduce kar dega.

topics.title: Structure and physical properties
topics.explain: C=O bond polar hai, isliye aldehydes aur ketones ke boiling points same mass ke hydrocarbons aur ethers se zyada, par alcohols se kam (apne molecules ke beech H-bonding nahi). Chhote members paani mein ghulte hain. Carboxylic acids ke boiling points aur bhi zyada: hydrogen-bonded dimers banate hain.

topics.title: Oxidation tests
topics.explain: Tollens' reagent (ammoniacal AgNO₃) → silver mirror; Fehling's solution (Cu²⁺ tartrate complex) → laal Cu₂O; strong oxidants ketones ko sirf C–C todkar oxidise karte hain. Aromatic aldehydes Fehling's test nahi dete.

topics.title: Preparation of carboxylic acids
topics.explain: 1° alcohols aur aldehydes ka oxidation, alkylbenzenes ka side-chain oxidation (KMnO₄ → benzoic acid), nitriles aur amides ka hydrolysis, aur Grignard reagent + CO₂ phir hydrolysis.

topics.title: Reactions of carboxylic acids
topics.explain: Metals aur alkalis (salts), NaHCO₃ (CO₂ ki effervescence — acids ko phenols se alag karta hai), PCl₅ ya SOCl₂ (acid chlorides), acid ke saath alcohols (esterification), NH₃ phir garam (amides), LiAlH₄ (1° alcohols). Benzoic acid ke electrophilic substitution mein –COOH meta-directing.

topics.title: Uses
topics.explain: Formalin (40% HCHO) biological specimens ko surakshit rakhta hai; acetone common solvent; acetic acid (sirka, ~6–8%); benzoic acid ke salts food preservatives; esters phalon ko khushboo dete hain.

topics.title: Mechanism of nucleophilic addition
topics.explain: Nucleophile planar ke upar ya neeche se electrophilic carbonyl carbon par attack karta hai, carbon sp² se sp³ banta hai, aur tetrahedral alkoxide intermediate H⁺ lekar product deta hai.

ratta: Tollens' & Fehling's: aldehyde yes, ketone no.
Iodoform: CH₃CO– or CH₃CH(OH)–; yellow CHI₃.
RCN + R′MgX → ketone;  excess RMgX: C=O → 3° alcohol par –CN ketone par rukta.
